_meta.note: Every user-adjustable preference, with WHERE it lives and therefore what it promises. 'account' follows the person to any device; 'device' lives in this browser only; 'owned-device' is device storage stamped with the owner so it never crosses between people on shared hardware (T121). A preference whose scope is not stated is a promise nobody made.

known_gaps: No single settings HOME exists: preferences are adjusted where they apply (persona at the picker, language in chrome, filters in place). That is defensible - a knob next to the thing it changes beats a distant panel - but it means there is nowhere to review or reset them all. Surfacing decision for Ian.
Notification read-state is device-local (T107): a badge cleared on the phone stays on the PC.
